PDF_001: Ancol Art Market serves as an aspiration center for local artists from Jakarta and Indonesia. The government established this center in 1975. Tourists and art collectors can directly watch the artists finishing their masterpieces in the location. Visitors can purchase the desired artwork directly from the creators. The art market also holds a traditional art show performance every weekend.
PDF_002: Both destinations represent the newest attractions in the Ancol Dreamland Complex. Tourists visiting Allianz Ecopark can enjoy the beauty of the city park and partake in various fun ecofriendly activities. Faunaland offers tourists a different experience. Visitors can play with various exotic animals from all over the world.
PDF_003: Dunia Fantasi stands as the most historic and famous amusement park in Jakarta and Indonesia. Developers built this park in 1983. Dufan continuously serves as a favorite travel destination. The park boasts various rides with Indonesian and international themes. Tourists of all ages can enjoy these exciting attractions.
PDF_004: Lagoon Beach represents one of the six beaches located in the Ancol Dreamland Area. Tourists from all walks of life popularize this beach. Visitors can have a beachside picnic while playing with sand and swimming in the ocean. The management often holds dazzling water ski shows at the beach. The location also offers many attractive photography spots.
PDF_005: Ocean Dream Samudera operates as an ocean themed park located in Ancol Dreamland. This destination provides various attractions such as sea animal shows and an underwater theatre featuring 4D movies. Actors perform various thrilling and exciting stunt shows. Visitors can explore a giant sized clear water creature aquarium.
PDF_006: Putri Duyung Resort serves as a family holiday destination dating back to 1973. The resort houses more than 100 cottages featuring unique designs. This destination provides a perfect alternative for tourists to escape their daily routines. Visitors can enjoy facilities such as swimming in a seaside pool. Guests can also take a relaxing bike ride or eat a romantic beachside dinner.
PDF_007: People previously called this destination Ancol Swimming Arena before it underwent a revitalization process. Atlantis stands on 7 hectares of land and offers many interesting attractions in the theme park. Visitors can explore a floating pool, a wave pool, various slides, and interesting outbound activities. This destination represents the second largest attraction in Ancol Dreamland.
PDF_008: Sea World Ancol functions as an educational travel destination featuring attractions of various unique sea biotas. The management spreads attractions throughout 28 areas. Tourists can interact directly with various seawater and freshwater animals. Guests can witness a live feeding show and walk under the sea through the underwater tunnel.
PDF_009: Jetski Café at Pantai Mutiara operates as a culinary travel destination. The restaurant serves Asian and Western fusion dishes. The beautiful ocean view from the restaurant serves as the specialty of this destination. Visitors can experience the sensation of dining alongside the sound of crashing waves. Guests can feel the romantic atmosphere while enjoying the sunset.
PDF_010: Muara Angke stands as a popular natural tourist destination. The area features an abundance of mangrove trees to prevent the abrasion process. Two mangrove forest natural tourist destinations exist in Muara Angke currently. These include the Muara Angke Wildlife Refuge and the Angke Kapuk Mangrove Nature Park. Both destinations serve as picnic locations and provide educational tourism experiences featuring diverse vegetation and uniquely interesting wildlife.
PDF_011: Muara Baru Modern Fish Market provides a complete, clean, and comfortable seafood market in Jakarta. Visitors can freely pick their preferred sea products at affordable prices. Cooks prepare the food at available seafood restaurants located on the second floor of the market. Customers can enjoy their meals directly afterward.
PDF_012: Urban Farm represents a new culinary destination located in Pantai Indah Kapuk. Lush and serene surroundings feature various fertile plants to offer an oasis in the middle of the city. Visitors can take a quick break from stress and busy city life. Guests can relax and enjoy delicacies at this location.
PDF_013: Pantjoran PIK functions as a dining establishment featuring Chinese inspired architecture and concepts. This location has become a popular destination in Jakarta. Visitors must follow strict health protocols to enjoy attractions such as lion dances, traditional music, and customs of China. The site provides abundant choices of dishes and offers many attractive spots to take pictures.
PDF_014: Sedayu Indo Golf operates as a new, unique, and attractive sport destination located in Golf Island at the coast of Jakarta. The establishment provides various styles of golf courses. Players can choose from relatively flat parkland golf or links golf adorned with natural hazards. A smooth ocean breeze accompanies players, making this destination a favorite of golf enthusiasts.
PDF_015: Baywalk Mall serves as a modern shopping destination in North Jakarta. This facility offers a different concept from other malls and shopping centers. The mall provides international brands and a resting spot with an ocean view called the waterfront. Visitors can escape from the hustle and bustle of the city while waiting for a beautiful sunset.
PDF_016: Shiva Mandir Temple stands as the largest Hindu place of worship in Jakarta. The architecture of the temple looks uniquely and authentically similar to temples in India. Builders constructed the structure similar to a pagoda and decorated it with statues of Hindu Gods and Goddesses. The management routinely holds various Hindu prayers, worship services, and rituals at this temple.
PDF_017: ART: 1 New Museum operates as an art gallery. The facility showcases the masterpieces of Indonesian contemporary legendary artists. The modern and well designed museum interior makes this location a mandatory destination for tourists and art lovers. The museum also features a comfortable outdoor café to serve as a resting spot for visitors.
PDF_018: Jakarta International Velodrome functions as a biking race arena. This facility represents the pride of the inhabitants of Jakarta and Indonesia. The velodrome hosts many world class competitions featuring participants from across the world. The eco friendly stadium also provides multifunctional fields. The public can use these fields to cycle leisurely.
PDF_019: Ramlie Musofa Mosque serves as a place of worship and a religious travel destination located by the side of Sunter Lake. This mosque features grand and beautiful architecture similar to the Indian Taj Mahal. The architecture incorporates Arabic, Indian, and Chinese influences. Artists wrote Al Quran calligraphy on the building in Bahasa Indonesia, Arabic, and Chinese.
PDF_020: Jakarta International Equestrian Park stands as the largest horse race arena in Southeast Asia. The facility occupies 35 hectares of land and fulfills international quality standards. The location provides five race tracks for various equestrian categories. This equestrian park also offers horse riding courses for children and adults. Experienced trainers teach these courses.
